pre_run_sequence: Confirm OOS runtime integrity guard is PASS relative to frozen engine commit.
Confirm canonical T0 file and rules fingerprint are unchanged.
Do not alter model rules, thresholds, hierarchy, pair logic, runtime payload or anchor prices.
Run the requested checkpoint evaluator only on or after its evaluation date.
If ECB fixing is not yet available, accept WAITING_FOR_ECB_FIXING and rerun later; never substitute another market source.
evaluation_sequence: Use the first common ECB reference-rate fixing available on or after the checkpoint date.
Reconstruct all G8 crosses from that single common fixing.
Score only pairs with a canonical favored side in T0.
Exclude pairs without a canonical favored side from hit-rate scoring.
Record overall hit rate, by-quality hit rate and every pair return without changing any signal definition.
post_run_sequence: Commit the evaluation artifact in validation only.
Populate the standard checkpoint report from the frozen evaluation artifact.
Separate what worked, what failed and what is inconclusive.
Do not tune after 1W or 4W; treat them as evidence accumulation checkpoints.
After 12W, review 1W+4W+12W jointly before deciding whether any research or model change is justified.

failure_handling.ecb_fetch_error: Retry the same canonical ECB source; do not replace it with a different price source for convenience.
failure_handling.missing_common_fixing: Return WAITING_FOR_ECB_FIXING and do not create a scored checkpoint artifact.
failure_handling.fingerprint_mismatch: STOP. Treat as possible OOS contamination and investigate before evaluation.
failure_handling.runtime_guard_failure: STOP. Do not score the checkpoint until the runtime diff is explained and the OOS validity decision is made.
failure_handling.unexpected_evaluator_error: Fix validation-only infrastructure if possible; do not modify model rules or T0 to make the run pass.

interpretation_rules.1W: Early read only. No tuning and no structural conclusion from a single short horizon.
interpretation_rules.4W: Intermediate validation. Compare persistence by signal quality, but still no rule change.
interpretation_rules.12W: First complete forward cycle. Jointly assess all horizons and only then open post-OOS research if warranted.

guardrails: No cherry-picking checkpoints or fixing dates.
No replacing canonical ECB prices with discretionary alternatives.
No removal of losing pairs from the frozen eligible set.
No threshold, weight, turning-point or confidence tuning before the first complete 12W review.
